title: Performance Engineering & Scale Capstone
description: Study throughput and scaling efficiency, stragglers and data-pipeline balance, configuration experiments with accelerate or deepspeed, and capstone: fit, scale and recover a training job. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Throughput and scaling efficiency
lessons.description: Calculate speedup and efficiency for a four-device run that is 2.8 times faster.
lessons.conceptOverview: Report useful examples or tokens per second with the workload definition. Scaling efficiency compares observed speedup with added resources under a chosen scaling regime. Strong scaling keeps total work fixed; weak scaling grows work with resources. Do not mix them silently.

lessons.title: Stragglers and data-pipeline balance
lessons.description: Correlate per-rank step time with valid tokens and data-loading time.
lessons.conceptOverview: A synchronous job often waits for its slowest rank. Uneven sequence lengths, data loading, storage, or hardware can create stragglers. Compare rank-level timing distributions and batch characteristics before changing collective libraries or adding devices.
lessons.whyItMatters: Investigate rank-level imbalance rather than only average step time.

lessons.title: Configuration experiments with Accelerate or DeepSpeed
lessons.description: Plan a baseline, precision-only, sharding-only, and combined experiment.
lessons.conceptOverview: Orchestration tools simplify launch and state handling but do not choose the correct workload assumptions. Keep configuration, software versions, and measured outcomes together. Change one major strategy at a time so a result can be attributed and reproduced.
lessons.whyItMatters: Use controlled experiments to understand configuration effects.

lessons.title: Capstone: fit, scale and recover a training job
lessons.description: Produce a memory budget, topology diagram, benchmark table, and verified checkpoint restoration.
lessons.conceptOverview: Start from a reproducible single-device baseline, estimate state memory, and choose a parallel strategy. Measure throughput, memory, and quality under an explicit budget. Include a failure-and-recovery drill and report when added hardware stops being worthwhile.
lessons.whyItMatters: Evaluate capacity, speed, quality, and recovery together.
